source_title: Cruise company had troubled history before abandoning passengers in Cambodia
source_excerpt:
The residential cruise company behind The Odyssey was plagued by lawsuits and a failed health inspection, records reveal, before it abruptly forced more than 200 passengers to disembark in Cambodia with no immediate alternative lodgings Tuesday .
